notes_for_editor: Only source is one row of the Forest Fire Lookout Association Minnesota list (name, county, coordinates, Tower, Gone). It was not read and may not be this site. The story is about 35 words, far below the 120-word target, because no other source was found. Hold for a Minnesota DNR or Aitkin County Historical Society source before publishing.
